short_description: On-call structural engineering services for diverse university campus building projects.

- However, this is an on-call/multi-project campus services contract without defined landmark structures, spans, or special lightweight/long-span features.
- No clear indication of architecturally exceptional, large-span, bridge, roof, or stadium structures.
- Presence of planning and structural review components makes it strategically relevant, but only moderately prioritized due to lack of project-specific technical ambition.
